notes: One big person hunting doll-sized people through a house is a chase with a way out, which is Survival's Escape preset - the pressure is a pursuing threat rather than a locked door, so it is not Puzzle. warren-looping is the preset's own shape and is kept because a house rendered at doll scale is exactly the interconnected-circles case: a single cornered corridor would make the chase unfair, and that topology cannot be guaranteed from an image, so the P6 stands. gate-escape is the win the answers name - the small people escape the house - and it sits in the outer wall as the round trigger; cover-los becomes the crawlspaces under and behind the oversized furniture, which is the only hiding the scale offers. building-interior was dropped even though the preset lists it: the house interior is the entire map rather than a structure entered from an exterior, so there is no outside-to-inside transition to build and no P3. Decided without a user: the cosy realistic home and normal-but-oversized furniture set the dressing, and one hunter against several small players is assumed since the prompt says one big person.
